trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening story mission. It pops on its own as Chapter 1 begins, so just ride the line.

steps.text: Play through the opening main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.
The trophy is automatic and cannot be missed; no choices or collectibles gate it.
Keep cheats off for the whole run: they disable trophies and saving on the file.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The pop arrives a little late, once Chapter 2 is under way.

steps.text: Complete every main mission in Chapter 1.
The trophy actually lands after you finish the first main mission of Chapter 2, so do not panic if it seems missing.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. One Chapter 1 balcony session with Lucia is the run's only missable moment — grab it before the chapter ends.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, on a morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in Jason's kitchen; when she walks to the balcony to meditate, follow her and choose Accept.
That balcony session is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and PowerPyx had done it when the trophy popped, so treat it as required.
Work through the 18 meditations spread over 10 locations; meditating as both Jason and Lucia at one spot adds +2 to the counter.
Follow the running total under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish every level of any one of the four arcade games. Three of them run on the TV at home from Chapter 1.

steps.text: Three games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — run on the home TV and are playable from Chapter 1.
Finish every level of any one game once; you do not need its challenge medals.
The fourth game, Bang For Your Buck, sits on arcade machines around the world if you prefer it.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal's fishing questline, unlocked in Chapter 1, ends with a head-to-head fishing challenge. Beat him.

steps.text: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Afterwards Cal texts you a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon; follow his fishing questline from there.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge he sets you.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, the pop is delayed into the next chapter.

steps.text: Complete the main missions of Chapter 2.
The trophy lands shortly after, once you finish the first main mission of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A single Chapter 2 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.
The trophy unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app. They unlock in Chapter 2 and double as parking for On the Spot.

steps.text: Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app; the 4 garages the story gives you are not required.
The set costs $160,000 in total; robbery income from Chapters 3–4 covers it quickly.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Respray and register 10 stolen cars with Moses through the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first — every registration needs a parking spot.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission for Moses.
Buy garage space first, because each registration needs a parking spot to live in.
Drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register; cheap cars keep the cost down.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With duo free-roam unlocked, raise 4 stars together and escape the heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easy exit.

steps.text: Wait until the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break unlocks free-roaming together as Jason and Lucia.
Call your partner (hold right on the D-pad and press Triangle), then raise a 4-star wanted level.
Escape through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County and keep going until you leave the red heat zone, which is when it pops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while the wanted level never drops. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City are the reliable route.

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner and keep an active wanted level for the whole run.
Rob 3 shops back to back without the wanted level dropping; the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well.
Loot a few items per store and crack the back-room safe; the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third shop, and a 4th shop fixes a near miss.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat on both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Training together raises both bars at once.

steps.text: From Chapter 2's Coffee Break on, you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call the other to join you.
Check each character's Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia; raise it by working out at fitness clubs marked under Map > Activities.
Always train together: while you work out with one character, the partner trains too, so both bars climb at once until both are maxed.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five-quest strand at the Thrillbilly Mudclub. It is marked after Coffee Break and stays open after the story.

steps.text: Billy's strand is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete his five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
The strand stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work Bret Vogel's hunting strand as Jason. His 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway, so the unique animal comes on the way.

steps.text: As Jason, answer Bret Vogel's text after Chapter 2's Coffee Break and do his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County.
Bret then marks hunting spots; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him.
Which single animal triggers the trophy is still being confirmed; clearing his Target Decks (15 are needed for 100% anyway) covers it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The pop lands two missions into Chapter 4 — chapter trophies run late by design.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3's main missions.
It pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4.
If a chapter trophy ever looks missing, play on into the next chapter before worrying — they all unlock late.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A single Chapter 3 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.
The trophy unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five Lucia-only quests in Belville. Her strand starts with a phone call in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Andy's Lucia-only strand starts in Chapter 3, when she calls and texts her address in Belville.
Finish her five quests, from Climbing the Cellerichain through Puff Puff Pass.
All five remain available after the story, so the strand is not missable.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List. The WAiNK app tells you whether a car you are looking at is one he wants.

steps.text: Randy's Wish List opens in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you deliver him a Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list; scan candidates with the WAiNK app to check whether he wants them.
Cars he marks appear at fixed spots, and the east of Vice City around Vice Beach is rich hunting; undamaged deliveries pay more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason's strand for Tyrone: burn down the Synthetic Labs across Vice City, then finish his follow-up quest.

steps.text: Tyrone's Jason-only strand is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple across Vice City for the Take Out Kitty Litter quest.
After enough labs fall, Tyrone hands you the follow-up, Spin On This; finishing it unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Slip into a jewelry store with the Snap Gun, loot the safe and wipe the footage without ever tripping the alarm.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to receive the Snap Gun and unlock jewelry store robberies.
Enter a jewelry store through its back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, so no alarm trips.
Find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm; it pops after you leave.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: One specific blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom. Hack in with the Key Cloner and drive straight out through the window.

steps.text: Get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee inside.
Drive it straight out through the showroom window; only that specific car counts, and the trophy pops as you drive away.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of marked bills through fences. Yasmani pays best, and Chapter 4's vaults move the total fast.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays best.
The $250,000 total accumulates across robberies; single bank vaults can hold up to $205,000 once they open in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 finale trophy: finish the chapter, ending with Starting From Zero.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4, ending with its final main mission, Starting From Zero.
Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A single Chapter 4 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.
The trophy unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A single Chapter 4 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.
The trophy unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A single Chapter 4 story mission at the airport. Automatic and unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.
The trophy unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape. The first vault is scripted in a Chapter 4 optional mission; the rest come from Yasmani's van tips.

steps.text: Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to learn vault robberies; the first vault is part of the mission.
Afterwards pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips, follow a van to its bank and slip into the open vault with your partner carrying a bag.
Escape the 4-star wanted level on a fast motorcycle; any 5 of the 8 vaults earn the trophy, though 100% wants all 8.
Yasmani sells further tips after the first, and each van leads to a different bank, so all 8 vaults are reachable this way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get out of the heat. The Chapter 4 vault mission hands you this one for free.

steps.text: The Chapter 4 optional mission that opens the vaults also earns this automatically, since a vault job counts as an armored-truck robbery.
Earlier method: block a roaming armored truck near a bank, blow its back doors with a sticky bomb and loot it.
Either way, the trophy only pops once you escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet that is docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly it about a kilometre out. Airfield planes do not count.

steps.text: At VCIA, pick a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (the E3/E4 terminal plane is easiest); airfield planes do not count.
Enter by the stairs beside the bridge, go up to the cockpit and taxi out to the runway.
Take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport; the unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Clear the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, taking all 3 key valuables inside. Missed items respawn, so it is not missable.

steps.text: Target the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, marked during Chapter 2's optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.

Inside, take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the golden Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun in the north-east corner, and the north-east office safe, blown open with sticky bombs.
The trophy pops once you escape the police; anything missed can be collected when the operation respawns, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A single Chapter 5 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy unlocks during the mission; Chapter 5 is the final chapter, and everything unfinished stays available in free-roam afterwards.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story. Free-roam continues afterwards, so nothing else on the line is locked behind it.

steps.text: Complete the final main mission of the story.
Automatic and unmissable; keep a manual save at each chapter start and end so you can revisit any moment.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's shipwreck strand: 7 treasure wrecks dived with a metal detector, starting in Chapter 1 and finishing late. He goes quiet, then returns — not missable.

steps.text: Kenton's strand is marked in Chapter 1 in Key Lento after the mission Island Dreams.
Dive his marked shipwrecks, dig up the treasure with the metal detector and bring each set back to him; there are 7 wrecks in all.
Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3, so the strand is not missable; progress shows under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 true stranger strands. Named contacts like Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count toward this one — strangers only.

steps.text: Only true stranger strands count; questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Andy, Billy and similar named contacts do not.
Confirmed strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street-race strand and Pilot Pete's delivery strand.
Watch the running total in the trophy tracker in the trophy list; all strands remain findable after the story.
Strands you have started show under Progress > Characters, each with its own quest list to finish.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Climb into a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and shoot enemies. The base sits on the island at the south-west edge of the map.

steps.text: Head to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
The Rhino tanks sit in the south of the base; enter through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb in and shoot at enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it standing by the bar. Thirty seconds, done.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it standing next to the bar and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The UFO encounter in the Kelly County woods. Go alone after 2 AM and look for the blinking car by the Starlet Motel road.

steps.text: Go alone, after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
If the blinking car is parked there, follow the path beside it into the woods toward the bright blue light; if not, leave and return until it spawns.
Approach the UFO, then help the woman it drops back to her car at the roadside.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no launch-week source has verified this trigger yet. The only lead in print links it to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, so this stop prints no invented method.

steps.text: Status: unconfirmed. PowerPyx lists this trigger as currently unknown, so this stop deliberately gives no method rather than an invented one.
The only lead in print is a suspected link to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
It is not missable as far as anyone has shown: it can be chased in free-roam once a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the trigger is not verified by any launch-week source. The description points at a melee attack from a moving vehicle; PowerPyx suspects kicking people from a motorcycle.

steps.text: Status: unconfirmed. PowerPyx lists the trigger as currently unknown, so no method is printed here on purpose.
The in-game hint and the description point to a melee attack from a moving vehicle; PowerPyx suspects kicking people from a motorcycle.
Treat it as a post-story experiment in free-roam until a source confirms the exact action.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one: the in-game 100% checklist. It is lenient — roughly 60% true completion — and only a few categories must be finished in full.

steps.text: Finish the story first; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and everything you already did counts.
It is lenient — roughly 60% true completion: most collectibles are partial, including 200 of 277 vehicle scans and 100 of 255 animal studies.
Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests must be done in full.
You need 70 of the 80 challenges and 300 stunts, so skip the hardest challenges.
Do optional missions as they appear; any 100 of the several hundred count toward the checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. Under-bridge flights are the fastest category to farm — and 100% wants 300, so keep going.

steps.text: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Under-bridge flights are the fastest category to farm.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map's Exploration filter.
Note the 100% checklist separately wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
For the checklist's 300, the split is 60 stunt jumps, 170 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 30 base jumps.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 range locations. Ranges are also mandatory for 100%, so this comes on the way.

steps.text: There are 12 shooting range locations holding 42 challenges between them.
Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 challenges.
Ranges must also be fully completed for the 100% checklist, so this comes on the way.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. Drone races are a full-completion category for 100%.

steps.text: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations, with 42 individual races between them.
Win a drone race at every one of the 14 locations.
Drone races are one of the categories the 100% checklist wants in full.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Repeats do not add to the count.

steps.text: There are 40 unique race locations across Leonida.
Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not add to the count.
Race challenge golds also feed the 100% checklist, which wants 10 of 13 race gold medals.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Most arrive via the story.

steps.text: The tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Do each type at least once; view them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
Most are introduced by the story, and the rest appear as you unfog the map, so this usually pops on its own.
Activities are marked with blue icons on the map's Activities filter if you need to hunt one down.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Any 50 of the 80 challenges. Since 100% needs 70, leave this late and pick off the easiest leftovers.

steps.text: There are 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10.
Complete any 50; the checkmark shows under Progress > Challenges.
Since 100% needs 70 of 80, this unlocks automatically on the way — leave it late and pick off the easiest leftovers.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan any 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags give well over 100 targets.

steps.text: Scan objects with the WAiNK app by holding up on the D-pad and R1.
Landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23) plus No Flusher tags give well over 100 targets.
Any 100 scans count, whichever you find first.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — scanning alone discovers them, no driving needed. Stand at a busy road and let traffic come to you.

steps.text: Stand at a busy road and scan passing traffic with the WAiNK app; scanning alone discovers a vehicle, no driving needed.
Boats and aircraft can be scanned too, not just road traffic.
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
The 100% checklist wants 200 base-model scans, so this trophy lands on the way.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Keep collecting afterwards — 15 sets feed the 100% checklist.

steps.text: Collectible cards come in 18 sets spread across the state.
Complete any 3 full sets.
Most sets also feed the 100% checklist, so keep collecting after the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the entire map. A plane is the fastest broom — sweep the water and the islands, not just the roads.

steps.text: Fully unfog the map by visiting every fogged area of Leonida.
A plane is the fastest way to clear the fog.
Check the map for leftover black patches over water and around the islands; those are the usual stragglers.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. The operations are marked in yellow as you approach them.

steps.text: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations between them, marked with yellow icons as you approach.
Rob at least one operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs; 100% wants all 39 operations.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five takedowns inside one Combat Focus. Fill the focus bar first, then line up gang enemies at an operation — police and civilians do not count.

steps.text: Activate Combat Focus with L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and marks weak spots but lasts only seconds.
Beforehand, eat, drink or shower to fill the focus bar and take Adrenaline to stretch it.
Line up 5 gang enemies at a gang operation and drop them with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556; police, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn money fastest.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types; the tally is cumulative.
Guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods and tattoos burn money fastest.
Clothing, haircuts and electronics count too, so ordinary shopping on the way to 100% adds up.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your criminal profile. Turn on the HUD notifications so you can see each one land; robberies feed it passively.

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that move your criminal profile; the trophy list itself shows your running count out of 500.
Turn on criminal profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications so each counting action shows the demon icon.
Robberies and enemy encounters feed it passively, so it normally pops during cleanup without farming.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The terminus. Earn the other 54 stops on the line and the platinum is yours — no multiplayer, no DLC.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies on this line.
No multiplayer or DLC is required; it is a single-player list.
